milestones.title: Accounts, access plans and the plans section
acceptance_criteria: Real people sign in with their own invited account and each one reaches exactly what their role or access plan allows; the shared APP_PASSWORD no longer opens the app; anyone can compare the four access plans in the public plans section.

Migration 037 applies on an empty isolated schema and again on an already migrated one without error, creates the account, role, session, link and sign-in attempt tables, and seeds exactly the six system roles.
Every page.tsx and route.ts under src/app matches exactly one entry of the route permission map, and the test fails naming any file that matches none or several.

The six system roles hold exactly these permissions: the four plan roles take theirs only from the plan catalogue, Entusiasta and Designer the assisted chat, the balloon counter and the catalogue, Designer Plus adds the cost calculator and Master Designer adds the Taller 3D with its scene AI, assembly plans and sheet, export, own projects and decorations and the ready-made decorations explorer; Empleado interno holds every plan permission, everyone's projects, AI spend and internal tools; Administrador holds every permission.

The plan catalogue holds exactly four plans in the order Entusiasta, Designer, Designer Plus and Master Designer, each with its name in Spanish and English (Entusiasta is Enthusiast in English; Designer, Designer Plus and Master Designer keep their names), its monthly price in COP and USD (free; 20,000 and 7; 45,000 and 14; 70,000 and 25), its tools in cumulative order with the Entusiasta chat described as with limits and the Designer chat as with higher limits and no limit number, extended chat, structure detection and advanced balloon detection marked not available yet, and its permission list; a catalogue with a missing name, price or tool, an unknown permission key or a plan that lacks a permission of the plan below it fails to load naming the plan and the field.

An administrator's invitation creates an invited account with a single-use link valid seven days; activating it sets a password of at least eight characters, records the data-notice version and date, and a second use of the same link is refused.
Signing in with the right email and password of an active account creates a session; a wrong password, an unknown email and a deactivated account all get the same generic refusal.
After five failed sign-ins for one email within fifteen minutes that email is refused for fifteen minutes even with the right password, and other emails are unaffected.
Deactivating, deleting or changing the role of the last active Administrador is refused; deleting an account removes its personal data rows.
npm run cuentas:primer-admin creates an invited Administrador for the given email and prints its activation link once, and refuses without changes when an active Administrador already exists.
Deactivating an account, changing its password or signing out ends its sessions on the next request, and a role change applies on the next request without signing in again.

Without a valid session a page request redirects to /login keeping the path and an API request gets 401 JSON; with a session lacking the mapped permission a page shows the no-access page and an API gets 403 JSON.
A cookie or form built from the old APP_PASSWORD no longer grants access, and no code path reads APP_PASSWORD.

With AUTH_LOCAL_SIN_RESTRICCIONES=1 under next dev, a request from 127.0.0.1, ::1 or localhost runs as the Administrador local account without signing in, and a request from any other address must sign in.
With AUTH_LOCAL_SIN_RESTRICCIONES set, next build, next start, a Vercel environment and the ai-api deployment refuse to start with an error naming the variable.
Every API route handler outside the public and own-auth exceptions calls the permission guard with the permission the map assigns to its path before doing any work.

Against a production build started with next start on the REQ-021 test database, one Entusiasta, one Designer Plus, one Master Designer, one Empleado interno and one Administrador account each reach exactly their mapped pages and APIs, a deactivated account loses access on its next request, and the old shared password is refused.
An independent security audit of SP-1 records every confirmed defect with the task that must redo it in the SP-1 findings ledger, and the ledger has no open critical or high finding.

tasks.title: Local no-restrictions mode that refuses to start outside next dev on loopback
tasks.objective: AUTH_LOCAL_SIN_RESTRICCIONES=1 lets the owner work locally as the Administrador local account without signing in, and any build, start or deployment with the variable set refuses to run.
tasks.estimate_rationale: Agent estimate in minutes: 20 mode and start guards + 10 ai-api refusal + 30 tests = 60. No comparable history.

complexity.justification: The refusal must fire in three places, next.config at build, instrumentation at start and the ai-api, with loopback detection per request.

scope.justification: One mode module, start guards in two existing files, an ai-api refusal and their tests.

evidence: command:python3 /home/david/.claude/skills/metodologia/scripts/bitacora.py --project pictures plan-json history --kind implement -> status unknown, no comparable samples
duration.justification: Twenty for the guards, ten for the ai-api and thirty for the tests make sixty minutes.

risk.justification: If the variable ever works in a deployment, anyone on the internet is an administrator of the pilot.

coupling.justification: It plugs into contract:session-guard from T1.4 as an alternative session source.

confidence.justification: Instrumentation and the Next config were read and the owner fixed the rule in round 5.

acceptance_criteria: With AUTH_LOCAL_SIN_RESTRICCIONES=1 under next dev, a request from 127.0.0.1, ::1 or localhost runs as the Administrador local account without signing in, and a request from any other address must sign in.
With AUTH_LOCAL_SIN_RESTRICCIONES set, next build, next start, a Vercel environment and the ai-api deployment refuse to start with an error naming the variable.
Without the variable next dev asks to sign in like production, and DEV_REQUIRE_LOGIN no longer changes anything.

verification.purpose: With AUTH_LOCAL_SIN_RESTRICCIONES=1 under next dev, a request from 127.0.0.1, ::1 or localhost runs as the Administrador local account without signing in, and a request from any other address must sign in.

tasks.estimate_rationale: Agent estimate in minutes: 70 guards on about 80 handlers + 70 moving 40 suites and the smoke to the helper + 40 guard-coverage test and fixes = 180. Mechanical but wide.

complexity.justification: Mostly mechanical: replace isAuthenticatedRequest with the guard and the permission the map gives each path.

scope.justification: About eighty handlers and forty test files change, a transversal edit across the repository.

evidence: command:python3 /home/david/.claude/skills/metodologia/scripts/bitacora.py --project pictures plan-json history --kind implement -> status unknown, no comparable samples

risk.justification: A handler left unguarded exposes a paid AI endpoint to anyone with any session.

coupling.justification: It touches route files that later subplans also edit, so it consumes contract:session-guard and must land before them.

evidence: command:grep -rln APP_PASSWORD src scripts services -> 59 files
